answer_1.quote: We verify the effectiveness of Re 3 Dial on three Chinese multi-turn open-domain dialogue benchmarks... Extensive experiments demonstrate that Re 3 Dial consistently and significantly enhances the dialogue model's ability to utilize long-range context, leading to more sensible and informative responses in multi-turn dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following automatic metrics for evaluation. PPL zero-shot measures the perplexity... BLEU-N measures the precision of the n-gram overlap... ROUGE-L measures the recall... Distinct-N measures the percentage of the unique n-grams.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a pair-wise human evaluation to study the models' performance when provided with dialogue contexts of different lengths... three annotators are hired to give a preference in sensibleness and informativeness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two model responses and judge which is more sensible (relevant and consistent) and which is more informative given the context.
